Write a report on the filings as one HTML page

Source: R/xbrl_report_html.R
xbrl_report.Rd

Renders what xbrl_report_data() gathered: the findings in sentences first, then the tables behind them. The page is a single self-contained file with no scripts, fonts or images to fetch, so it can be mailed, archived or opened anywhere. It follows the reader's light or dark setting and is written without pandoc or any other tool outside R.

Usage

xbrl_report(d, file, title = NULL, ...)

Arguments

d

A report from xbrl_report_data(), or facts from read_xbrl(), which are passed to it with ....

file

Where to write the page.

title

The page's title. By default it names the company, or the number of companies.

...

Passed to xbrl_report_data() when d is facts.

Value

The path written, invisibly.

See also

xbrl_report_data() for the content as data.

Other taxonomy: add_taxonomy(), check_breakdown(), check_cascade(), check_cashflow(), check_continuity(), check_inclusion(), check_movement(), check_statement(), read_taxonomy(), xbrl_accounts(), xbrl_company(), xbrl_fill(), xbrl_lines(), xbrl_movements(), xbrl_note_tables(), xbrl_panel(), xbrl_period(), xbrl_ratios(), xbrl_report_data(), xbrl_resolve(), xbrl_robustness(), xbrl_screen(), xbrl_standardise(), xbrl_validate()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
x <- read_xbrl("materiale/xbrl")
xbrl_report(x, "report.html", cvr = "12345678")
} # }
